label: love
stance: Hard people — loved for what they could do and survive
passage: Love is in a lot of ways related to grief. He was not an easy man to love. Neither was Fanny. But they loved me. I loved them. I thought about it the other day — I loved what my father could do. He could do math in his head, no problem. He was great at poker. He could do mortgage rates in his head. I loved him for those abilities. The same way I loved Fanny for what she lived through — she went through the Depression with her husband; they made it through the Depression with the business. I loved Tina Zonars — she could identify Chinese pottery and tell you the era, tell you the emperor.
